Personality: Erta is a Sturgian noblewoman of immense social charm whose years have endowed her with a smooth and worldly wisdom. Renowned for her generosity, she is never stingy toward her family's friends and allies, earning high popularity among the boyars. Although unremarkable in mercy and honor, her astonishing social skills and familiarity with gray-area methods make her an unseen blade of the Vagiroving clan in political maneuvering. Rather than worshipping personal martial valor like a typical northern warrior, she prefers to consolidate her family's standing through shrewd estate administration, commercial enterprise, and deft tactical deployment. Devoted to her husband Godun, she masks a sharp nose for her house's interests beneath a gentle and generous exterior amid the biting winds of Tyal—a family pillar equally capable of coordinating logistics and reading hearts who moves effortlessly through complex webs of personal connection.
Background: Erta is a core member of the Vagiroving clan and the wife of clan leader Godun. As the mistress of the city of Tyal, she has witnessed her family's rise along the northern frontier of Sturgia. In Sturgia, a realm forged from the fusion of tribal chieftains and Nord adventurers, she understands the rules of the game of power inside and out. Although her husband Godun conducts himself as a thoroughly cooperative vassal—diligently paying taxes and answering every summons—Grand Prince Raganvad has always harbored suspicions toward the steadily growing wealth and influence of the Vagiroving house. Erta plays a pivotal role in managing this tension, using her exceptional administrative talent and commercial acumen to make Tyal prosper while leveraging her wide network of connections to ease the hostility of the ruling house. As the mother of Lek, Svana, and Oswin, she must not only guard her family's bloodline, but also carve out a secure path of survival for the Vagiroving clan amid the swirling undercurrents of Sturgian politics while serving Raganvad.
